items.title: Blue Bonbon | Ethiopia
items.description:
Tasting notes: Blue Raspberry Bonbons, Red Currants, Candy, Floral

Producer Gargari Gutity

Farm Gedeb, Banko Gutity

Region Yirgacheffe

Variety 74110, 74112, 74165

Altitude 1,983 MASL

Process Supernatural (Grade 1)

Roast Light

Blue Bonbon tastes like the sweet you remember — blue raspberry bonbons up front, bright red currants behind, and layers of candy sweetness that build through the cup. Delicate florals keep it elegant.

This Grade 1 lot from the Gargari Gutity station in Gedeb is processed with the Supernatural method — whole cherries dried slowly in thicker layers with restricted sunlight and airflow, intensifying their natural sugars while preserving clarity.

We've roasted it for filter — clean, expressive and playful to the last sip.
items.flavour_notes: Blue Raspberry Bonbons, Red Currants, Candy, Floral

items.title: Citrus Bloom | Kenya
items.description:
Tasting notes: Orange, Mandarin, Yuzu, Jasmine

Producer Githembe Coffee Factory

Farm Thirika Farmers Co-operative Society

Region Kiambu County

Variety SL28, SL34, Ruiru 11, Batian

Altitude 1,800 masl

Process Washed (AB)

Roast Light

Citrus Bloom comes from the Githembe Coffee Factory in Kiambu County, around 47 kilometres northwest of Nairobi, where the Thirika Farmers Co-operative Society grows coffee at roughly 1,800 metres on rich red volcanic soils under Grevillea shade trees.

Following harvest, cherries are meticulously hand-sorted and slowly sun-dried on raised tables — a careful AB-grade preparation that preserves the bold, classic character of Kenyan coffee.

Bright, vibrant and beautifully aromatic: sweet orange and juicy mandarin up front, a lively hit of yuzu bringing fresh citrus clarity, and delicate jasmine florals carrying through a clean, elegant finish.

items.title: Mum's Dessert | Peru
items.description:
Tasting notes: Stewed Apple, Candied Orange, Caramel, Cinnamon

Producer Milton Torres

Farm Los Cajones

Region Cajamarca

Variety Caturra

Altitude 1,800 MASL

Process Washed

Roast Light

Mum's Dessert is the cup you come home to. Stewed apple and candied orange first, smooth caramel as it cools, and a soft cinnamon warmth on the finish — like an apple dessert fresh from the oven.

Grown by Milton Torres at Los Cajones in Cajamarca, this classic washed Caturra matures slowly in the elevated conditions of the Peruvian Andes. Careful pulping, controlled fermentation and slow drying keep the cup clean and comforting.

We've roasted it for filter — warm, familiar and effortlessly drinkable.
items.flavour_notes: Stewed Apple, Candied Orange, Caramel, Cinnamon

items.title: Lemonade Stand | Kenya
items.description:
Tasting notes: Sparkling Lemonade, Yuzu, Rhubarb, Peach

Producer Karimikui Factory

Farm Rungeto Farmers Co-operative Society

Region Kirinyaga County

Variety SL28, SL34, Ruiru 11, Batian

Altitude 1,600–1,750 masl

Process Washed (AB)

Roast Light

Lemonade Stand is grown by the Rungeto Farmers Co-operative Society and processed at their Karimikui Factory in Kirinyaga County, where around 600 smallholder farmers cultivate coffee across the fertile red volcanic slopes of Mount Kenya at 1,600–1,750 metres.

Quality begins with careful hand-sorting before the cherries are pulped and fermented overnight. The coffee is then washed, graded by density, soaked, and slowly sun-dried on raised African beds for 7 to 15 days to ensure even moisture and preserve quality.

Bright, sparkling and beautifully expressive — lively sweetness of sparkling lemonade over fresh yuzu, a crisp rhubarb edge, and soft peach rounding out the cup with delicate fruit sweetness. Refreshing, clean and effortlessly vibrant.

items.title: Ultra Violet | Colombia
items.description:
Tasting notes: Blackberry, Blueberry, Boysenberry Ice Cream, Botanical

Producer Jairo Arcila

Region Quindío

Variety Castillo

Process Blackberries Washed Co-Ferment

Roast Light

Some coffees whisper their fruit. Ultra Violet doesn't. This blackberries washed co-ferment from Jairo Arcila is pure purple — blackberry and blueberry up front, a scoop of boysenberry ice cream through the middle, and a soft botanical lift that keeps the whole thing composed.

Ripe Castillo cherries are fermented with fresh blackberries before a careful wash and slow dry. The result is deep, berry-saturated and creamy without ever tipping into heavy. If Starburst Soda was the candy aisle, this is the berry patch at dusk.

We've roasted it for filter — the brew that lets all that colour through.
items.flavour_notes: Blackberry, Blueberry, Boysenberry Ice Cream, Botanical

items.title: Strawberries and Cream | Ethiopia
items.description:
Tasting notes: Strawberry, Vanilla Cream, Light Lemon

Producer Urabeast

Farm South Part, Urabeast

Region Guji, Oromia

Variety 74110, 74112

Altitude 2,037 MASL

Process Kombucha Natural (Grade 1)

Roast Light

Some flavours you don't have to explain. Strawberries and Cream opens exactly the way it sounds — ripe strawberry first, then a smooth vanilla cream that settles over the whole cup. A light touch of lemon keeps it fresh.

This Grade 1 lot from the Urabeast station in Guji is dried as whole cherry through a carefully controlled, kombucha-inspired fermentation. Naturally occurring yeasts and bacteria build layers of fruit and sweetness while the cherries dry slowly.

We've roasted it for filter — soft, creamy and quietly nostalgic.

items.title: Cinnamon Bunz | Colombia
items.description:
Tasting notes: Caramel Choc, Cherry Ripe, Icing Sugar, Cinnamon Bun

Producer Jairo Arcila + Inzá Smallholders

Farm Santa Mónica + Inzá smallholder farms

Region Quindío + Inzá, Cauca

Variety Castillo, Caturra

Altitude 1,450–2,000 masl

Process Honey Cinnamon Co-Ferment + Washed

Roast Medium-Light

Caramel chocolate, a lift of Cherry Ripe, soft icing sugar and the warm spice of a cinnamon bun fresh from the oven.

Two Colombian coffees in one cup. Sixty percent is Jairo Arcila's Castillo from Santa Mónica in Quindío, fermented dry and anaerobic for 72 hours with cinnamon, then dried as a honey. The other forty is a washed Caturra and Castillo from smallholders in Inzá, Cauca, bringing plum, tangerine and a touch of nutmeg.

Roasted for both filter and espresso. Sweet and creamy either way, with a long cinnamon finish.
items.flavour_notes: Caramel Choc, Cherry Ripe, Icing Sugar, Cinnamon Bun

items.title: Tropical Thunder | Colombia
items.description:
Tasting notes: Passionfruit, Guava, Spiced Rum, Lavender

Producer Jairo Arcila

Farm Santa Monica

Region Quindío

Variety Yellow Sudan Rume

Altitude 1,400–1,450 MASL

Process Natural

Roast Light

Tropical Thunder doesn't ease in. Ripe passionfruit and pink guava arrive in one electric burst, a warming spiced-rum sweetness builds through the middle, and delicate lavender lifts the finish.

This is a rare one — Yellow Sudan Rume, an unusual yellow-cherry mutation of the prized variety, grown by Jairo Arcila at Santa Monica in Quindío. The cherries pass through 45 hours of aerobic fermentation before a slow dry on raised beds.

We've roasted it for filter — bold, composed and impossible to ignore.

items.title: Peach Petal | Colombia
items.description:
Tasting notes: Peach, Poached Pear, Bergamot, Soft Florals

Producer Felipe Arcila

Farm Jardines del Encanto

Region Quindío

Variety Red Gesha

Altitude 1,900 MASL

Process Natural (Grade 1)

Roast Light

Peach Petal is a rare one — a natural Red Gesha from Felipe Arcila's Jardines del Encanto. Soft ripe peach opens the cup, poached pear follows, and bergamot brings a lifted citrus elegance. Gentle florals linger on the finish.

Red Gesha is recognised for elegant florals, refined acidity and complex fruit. After harvest, whole cherries pass through a short aerobic fermentation and a controlled anaerobic rest below 22°C, before drying slowly on raised beds.

We've roasted it for filter, and offer it in 100g pouches alongside the standard sizes. Silky, expressive, remarkably clear.
items.flavour_notes: Peach, Poached Pear, Bergamot, Soft Florals

items.title: Sticky Fingers | Brazil
items.description:
Tasting notes: Vanilla Syrup, Nougat, Raw Honey, Chocolate Milk

Producer Campos Altos Smallholders

Farm Campos Altos Smallholders

Region Campos Altos

Variety Red Bourbon

Altitude 1,000–1,050 masl

Comfort in a cup. A natural Red Bourbon from the Campos Altos smallholders, high in Brazil's Cerrado Mineiro — smooth, sweet and endlessly drinkable. items.description:

Producer Selected regional producers

Farm Samaria

Region Belén de Umbría, Risaralda

Variety Caturra

Altitude 1,500–1,800 masl

Process Sugar Cane Decaf (EA)

Roast Medium

Golden Hour is our sugarcane decaf from Belén de Umbría in Colombia's renowned Risaralda coffee-growing region, where the Samaria farm — in the same family for four generations — anchors a lot of carefully selected Caturra from regional producers at 1,500–1,800 metres.

After harvest, the cherries undergo a traditional washed process with a 12-hour fermentation before being carefully patio-dried. The coffee is then transported to Descafecol in Tolima and naturally decaffeinated using the renowned sugarcane (EA) process — gently removing caffeine while preserving the coffee's sweetness, structure and clarity.

Golden Hour delivers everything we look for in a comforting espresso: notes of dark chocolate, brown sugar and honeycomb, supported by a smooth body, gentle sweetness and a clean, malt-biscuit finish. An espresso that doesn't ask you to compromise — whether it's your first cup of the morning or your last of the evening.

items.title: Seasonal Blend
items.description:
Origin: Ethiopia, Colombia, Brazil

Varietal: Mixed

Process: Natural, Washed

Altitude: 1500-1800 MASL

Tasting Notes: Milk Choc, Biscuit, Blueberry, Lemon

Colombia Popayan Reserve

Popayan Reserve is located in the region of Cauca at 1700 MASL. The region's topography is perfect to grow exceptional coffee. Sheltered by the Andes mountain range, which helps generate homogeneous climatic and altitudinal characteristics. The result is a balanced profile with floral and caramel notes. The Colombian component contributes sweetness to our blend with rich chocolate and caramel flavours.

Brazil Samba Reserve

Samba Reserve is an exceptional blend of natural processed coffees. Grown within 1000-1300 MASL and produced by carefully selected growers. Farm-level traceability from Carmo de Minas region, which is in the south of Minas Gerais. This coffee was carefully picked, selecting only the ripest cherries. The cherries then underwent a rigorous sorting process using a Lavador machine. The coffee is then sun-dried on patios for three days before being finished in mechanical dryers for 72 hours. The Brazilian component contributes the full body and richness to our blend.

Ethiopia Limu

This region shares many characteristics with the Southern regions, especially Yirgacheffe and Siamo, coffees from the three regions share floral notes with citrus acidity. Though, Limu is known for having a fuller body. Limu is famous for it's forests and abundant supply of water, making the soil well drained and acidic. The Ethiopia brings a rounded citrus acidity as well as berry and tart notes.

We roast all three regions separately, then manually combine our specific ratios post-roast.

Cafe Brewing

Below is the recipe that we use in our cafe on a Mahlkonig E65s.

20g In - 40g Out - 28-32s

Home Brewing

We understand that brewing at home can be much different.

Below is a starting point, but we recommend you adjust to taste.

18g In - 38g Out - 30s

Troubleshooting

Tasting Sour? Grind coffee finer.

Tasting Bitter? Grind coffee coarser.

Tasting Thin? Increase dose in.

Tasting Heavy? Decrease dose in.
